instructions.title: Protocols & Guidelines
instructions.subtitle: Work guides — Smart Farm AI
instructions.no_custom_desc: Your manager hasn't added any guidelines yet.
feeding_items: Check feeder levels before 07:00 every morning.
Ensure clean water is always available — clean drinkers if cloudy.
Follow feeding phases: Start (D1–D14), Growth (D15–D28), Finish (D29+).
Record amount consumed in the ERP every morning (🌾 Feed module).
Never mix feeds from different phases without manager authorization.
In case of excessive heat (>32°C), increase watering frequency.
health_items: Observe behavior at each pass: crowding, lethargy, open beak = alert.
Report any mortality over 3 head per day immediately to the manager.
Never administer a vaccine or medication without written manager validation.
Record all health acts in the ERP (💊 Health module) the same day.
In case of respiratory symptoms (cough, discharge), isolate suspects immediately.
Wear PPE (gloves, mask) when handling medications or vaccines.
cleaning_items: Disinfect drinkers every 48 hours with 0.5% chlorine solution.
Collect carcasses every morning and place in the dedicated bin (sealed bag).
Minimum 14-day sanitary void between batches — do not shorten this period.
Wet litter → report immediately via the app (Report), turn the litter.
Mandatory PPE in buildings: overshoes + mask + dedicated clothing. Remove at exit.
Footbath at entry: check level and concentration daily.
emergency_items: Mass mortality (>20 head/hour): call vet + alert manager immediately. DO NOT wait.
Ventilation failure: open manual vents, call maintenance, evacuate animals if T° > 35°C.
Fire: call 197 (fire brigade), cut electricity, evacuate poultry by zone if possible.
Suspected contagious disease (AI, Newcastle): isolate batch, block entries, alert UTAP at +216 71 841 222.
Power failure: start backup generators, check fans and heating.
Emergency numbers: Farm manager | Veterinarian | UTAP | Fire brigade 197 — posted at entrance.
